title: How I write my novels
author: Duchess

authorInfo.bio: Duchess (–1897) wrote The Haunted Chamber: A Novel. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
works: The story of my first novel; How a novel is written
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.

description: "How I write my novels" by Duchess is a reflective writing on the creative process of novel writing, extracted from Mrs. Hungerford's work "An anxious moment." It is likely penned in the late 19th century.
